sessions_basis: No fixed-length 'session' unit exists in these evidence sources. Two units are used per source: (a) one research-brief invoke (one FAST/NORMAL/DEEP/ULTRA `/agents/{id}/invoke` call that runs the research tool to completion) for entity_match, since entity_match fires once per retrieved web/search result inside that single research run; (b) one composer chat turn (one user message sent to the copilot agent) for composer_intent, since classify_intent runs exactly once per turn before tool-list construction. holding_relevance and thesis_contradiction have no live call site in this codebase (see notes) so no session unit could be derived for them from real transcripts.
